description: Type the refusal to delete a ruleset a release still refers to (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT: 'Cannot delete the ruleset ... because there are releases referring to this ruleset.'). Right after the release that referred to it is deleted, the reference lingers briefly; it surfaced as the generic BadRequest, so callers could not wait it out.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A release still refers to the ruleset (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT).

message.includes: there are releases referring to this ruleset
